_doc: HOME closes the AI sheet before the answer arrives (audit AUD-006): the turn's late speech is dropped.

ai.release_to_first_audio_heard_ms.count.why: no answer audio after the sheet was closed

audio.speaker.played_ms.why: only the listen tone plays (the answer's speech is about 10 s)

rt.closed.why: closing the sheet ends the turn's session, once the hub was told the utterance ended

hub.requests.ai.listen.end.why: the hub is not left waiting for the rest
